mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.title, r.description, r.prep_time, r.cook_time, r.difficulty, r.favorite_count, r.comment_count, r.views, r.likes, r.score, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.publish_time, r.updated_at, r.remark FROM recipes r

where.if: AND (r.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM recipe_ingredients ri LEFT JOIN category c ON ri.category_id = c.id WHERE ri.recipe_id = r.id AND c.designation LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) OR r.created_by IN (SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) )

choose.when: ORDER BY FIELD(r.difficulty, '简单', '中等', '困难')

mapper.insert: insert into recipes (id, title, description, prep_time, cook_time, difficulty, favorite_count, comment_count, views, likes, score, created_by, created_at, publish_time, updated_at, remark) values (#{id}, #{title}, #{description}, #{prepTime}, #{cookTime}, #{difficulty}, #{favoriteCount}, #{commentCount}, #{views}, #{likes}, #{score}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{publishTime}, #{updatedAt}, #{remark})
mapper.update:
update recipes
title = #{title},
description = #{description}, prep_time = #{prepTime}, cook_time = #{cookTime}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, favorite_count = #{favoriteCount}, comment_count = #{commentCount}, views = #{views}, likes = #{likes}, score = #{score}, created_by = #{createdBy}, publish_time = #{publishTime}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = NOW()
where id = #{id}
mapper.delete:
delete from recipes where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT CONCAT(#{imgBaseUrl}, im.stored_name) FROM images_record ir LEFT JOIN image_management im ON ir.image_id = im.id WHERE ir.recipe_id = r.id ORDER BY ir.sort ASC, ir.create_time ASC LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl, r.id FROM recipes r WHERE r.favorite_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.favorite_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT CONCAT(#{imgBaseUrl}, im.stored_name) FROM images_record ir LEFT JOIN image_management im ON ir.image_id = im.id WHERE ir.recipe_id = r.id ORDER BY ir.sort ASC, ir.create_time ASC LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl, r.title AS name, r.id FROM recipes r WHERE r.score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT CONCAT(#{imgBaseUrl}, im.stored_name) FROM images_record ir LEFT JOIN image_management im ON ir.image_id = im.id WHERE ir.recipe_id = r.id ORDER BY ir.sort ASC, ir.create_time ASC LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl, r.title AS name, r.id FROM recipes r WHERE r.views IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.views DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT CONCAT(#{imgBaseUrl}, im.stored_name) FROM images_record ir LEFT JOIN image_management im ON ir.image_id = im.id WHERE ir.recipe_id = #{recipeId} ORDER BY ir.sort ASC, ir.create_time ASC

SELECT r.id, r.title, r.description, r.prep_time AS prepTime, r.cook_time AS cookTime, r.difficulty, r.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, r.comment_count AS commentCount, r.views, r.likes, r.score, r.created_by AS createdBy, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.publish_time AS publishTime, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, r.remark, u.user_name AS authorName, (SELECT CONCAT(#{imgBaseUrl}, im.stored_name) FROM image_management im WHERE im.id = u.avatar) AS authorAvatar, (SELECT CONCAT(#{imgBaseUrl}, im.stored_name) FROM images_record ir LEFT JOIN image_management im ON ir.image_id = im.id WHERE ir.recipe_id = r.id ORDER BY ir.sort ASC, ir.create_time ASC LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.designation ORDER BY c.sort SEPARATOR ',') FROM recipe_category rc LEFT JOIN category c ON rc.category_id = c.id WHERE rc.recipe_id = r.id) AS categoryNamesStr, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.designation ORDER BY c.designation SEPARATOR ',') FROM recipe_ingredients ri LEFT JOIN category c ON ri.category_id = c.id WHERE ri.recipe_id = r.id) AS ingredientsStr FROM recipes r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.created_by = u.user_id
AND (r.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM recipe_ingredients ri LEFT JOIN category c ON ri.category_id = c.id WHERE ri.recipe_id = r.id AND c.designation LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ) OR u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM recipe_category rc WHERE rc.recipe_id = r.id AND rc.category_id = #{query.categoryId} )
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
ORDER BY r.favorite_count DESC
ORDER BY FIELD(r.difficulty, '简单', '中等', '困难')
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.title, r.description, r.prep_time AS prepTime, r.cook_time AS cookTime, r.difficulty, r.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, r.comment_count AS commentCount, r.views, r.likes, r.score, r.created_by AS createdBy, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.publish_time AS publishTime, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, r.remark, u.user_name AS authorName, (SELECT CONCAT(#{imgBaseUrl}, im.stored_name) FROM image_management im WHERE im.id = u.avatar) AS authorAvatar, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.designation ORDER BY c.sort SEPARATOR ',') FROM recipe_category rc LEFT JOIN category c ON rc.category_id = c.id WHERE rc.recipe_id = r.id) AS categoryNamesStr, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(#{imgBaseUrl}, im.stored_name) ORDER BY ir.sort ASC, ir.create_time ASC SEPARATOR ',') FROM images_record ir LEFT JOIN image_management im ON ir.image_id = im.id WHERE ir.recipe_id = r.id) AS imgUrlsStr,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.designation ORDER BY c.designation SEPARATOR ',') FROM recipe_ingredients ri LEFT JOIN category c ON ri.category_id = c.id WHERE ri.recipe_id = r.id) AS ingredientsStr FROM recipes r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.created_by = u.user_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
